## Tumor mutational burden

```{r tmb_pdf_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

tmb_conf_pdf <- pcg_report$settings$conf$somatic_snv$tmb
tmb_display_pdf <- tmb_conf_pdf$tmb_display
tmb_estimate_pdf <- pcg_report$content$tmb$sample_estimate |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$TMB_MEASURE == paste0("TMB_", tmb_display_pdf))
tmb_algo_pdf <- dplyr::case_when(
  tmb_display_pdf == "coding_and_silent" ~ "Coding and silent",
  tmb_display_pdf == "coding_non_silent" ~ "Coding non-silent",
  .default = "Missense only")
tmb_threshold_pdf <- pcg_report$content$tmb$tmb_high_threshold
tmb_high_pdf <- isTRUE(pcg_report$content$tmb$tmb_high)
sample_props_pdf <- pcg_report$settings$conf$sample_properties
tmb_plot_caption_pdf <- paste0(
  "Distribution of tumor mutational burden (TMB, log10 mutations/Mb) among ",
  "TCGA samples per primary tumor site (box: interquartile range; violin: ",
  "full distribution), sorted by descending median TMB. The highlighted row ",
  "corresponds to the query sample's primary site (", sample_props_pdf$site,
  "); the dashed line marks the TMB estimate of this sample. Axis labels ",
  "indicate the power of ten (e.g. 1 = 10 mutations/Mb).")
```

PCGR can estimate TMB in different manners, depending on the type of variants included in the calculation (*coding_non_silent*, *coding_and_silent*, and *missense_only*, see the documentation). Results from the method configured by the user (**`r tmb_algo_pdf`**) are shown here.

```{r tmb_pdf_filtering}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: true

## the *_detected flags are stored as 0/1 (as.logical() - isTRUE(1) is FALSE)
dp_filter <- isTRUE(as.logical(sample_props_pdf$dp_tumor_detected)) &&
  isTRUE(as.numeric(tmb_conf_pdf$tmb_dp_min) > 0)
af_filter <- isTRUE(as.logical(sample_props_pdf$vaf_tumor_detected)) &&
  isTRUE(as.numeric(tmb_conf_pdf$tmb_af_min) > 0)
if (dp_filter || af_filter) {
  cat("For TMB calculation, requirements for sequencing depth and/or ",
      "variant allele frequency (VAF) have been applied to filter out ",
      "low-quality variants",
      if (dp_filter) paste0(" (minimum depth: **", tmb_conf_pdf$tmb_dp_min, "**)"),
      if (af_filter) paste0(" (minimum VAF: **", tmb_conf_pdf$tmb_af_min, "**)"),
      ".\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("No dedicated filtering of variants based on sequencing depth or ",
      "variant allele frequency (VAF) has been applied for TMB ",
      "calculation.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r tmb_pdf_kpis}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr NROW(tmb_estimate_pdf) == 1

col_high <- pcgrr::color_palette$oncogenicity$values[1]
cat(pcgrr:::kpi_row_pdf(list(
  ## box color: dark (TMB below the TMB-high threshold) or red (TMB-high)
  list(title = "TMB estimate",
       value = paste(round(tmb_estimate_pdf$TMB_ESTIMATE, 2),
                     stringr::str_replace(tmb_estimate_pdf$TMB_UNIT,
                                          "^mutations/", "mut/")),
       color = if (tmb_high_pdf) col_high else NULL),
  list(title = "TMB algorithm", value = tmb_algo_pdf),
  list(title = "Effective target size",
       value = paste(pcg_report$settings$conf$assay_properties$effective_target_size_mb,
                     "Mb")))))
```

### TMB reference cohorts comparison

```{r tmb_pdf_reference_plot}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr NROW(pcg_report$content$tmb$tmb_reference) > 0
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6.2
#| fig-cap: !expr tmb_plot_caption_pdf

tumor_only_pdf <- isTRUE(as.logical(
  pcg_report$settings$conf$assay_properties$vcf_tumor_only))
tmb_plot_pdf <- pcgrr::plot_tmb_primary_site_tcga(
  pcg_report$content$tmb$tmb_reference,
  p_site = sample_props_pdf$site,
  tmb_estimates = pcg_report$content$tmb$sample_estimate,
  tmb_display_type = tmb_display_pdf,
  tumor_only = tumor_only_pdf)
pcgrr:::pdf_plot_theme(tmb_plot_pdf, base_size = 8)
```

```{r tmb_pdf_reference_note}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
cat(pcgrr:::note_box_pdf(paste0(
  "Be aware of the nature of the reference dataset (TCGA), which must be ",
  "taken into account during TMB interpretation of the query sample:\n\n",
  "- TCGA tumor samples are sequenced with a mean coverage of approximately 100X\n",
  "- TCGA somatic mutation calls are based on a consensus among variant ",
  "callers (each variant supported by a minimum of two algorithms)\n",
  "- TCGA somatic mutation calls are based on paired tumor-control ",
  "sequencing (tumor-only sequencing frequently produces higher numbers ",
  "due to more noise)\n",
  "- TCGA somatic mutation calls used for TMB calculation have been ",
  "filtered for sequencing depth (minimum DP = 30) and variant allele ",
  "frequency (minimum VAF = 0.05)"),
  title = "TMB reference comparison"))
```

```{r tmb_pdf_biomarkers}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(is.null(pcg_report$content$tmb$callset))

cat("### Biomarker evidence for TMB-High\n\n")
cat("The tumor mutational burden (", round(tmb_estimate_pdf$TMB_ESTIMATE, 1),
    " mutations/Mb, ", tmb_algo_pdf, ") is at or above the threshold for ",
    "TMB-High (", tmb_threshold_pdf, " mutations/Mb). Therapeutic ",
    "implications of TMB-High were retrieved from ",
    pcgrr:::bm_db_label_pdf(pcg_report), ", and are classified according ",
    "to the strength of evidence for the tumor type (", sample_props_pdf$site,
    "), following AMP/ASCO/CAP guidelines.\n\n", sep = "")
```
